honesty_note: This model classifies soil APPEARANCE from a photograph. It cannot determine NPK, pH, electrical conductivity or micronutrient concentrations. Laboratory soil testing provides accurate nutrient and pH values.

holdout_evaluation.note: Images quarantined before training in C:/Users/Hp/datasets/soil/holdout. Unlike val_accuracy, this split never drove EarlyStopping or checkpoint selection, so it is the honest generalisation figure.

val_accuracy_note: val_accuracy is measured on the Keras validation split, which also drove EarlyStopping and ModelCheckpoint, so it is model-selection contaminated. Use holdout_evaluation.accuracy as the honest number.
